research_rationale: EO 11434 (signed 1968-11-08; 33 FR 16485, Federal Register of November 13, 1968) deals with the administration of the Foreign Service personnel systems: policies and regulations (Sec. 1), the Boards established by EO 11264 (Sec. 2), the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System (Sec. 3), an amendment of Section 21 of EO 11264 (Sec. 4) and its effective date (Sec. 5). EO 12292 (effective as of 1981-02-15) revoked Sections 1, 3 and 5; Sections 2 and 4 survived until EO 12363 revoked EO 11264 on 1982-05-21, which is the latest first end and so the whole-order end. EO 12553 (1986-02-25) is the later formal revocation. The held OFR notes "Revoked in part by: EO 12292" and "Revoked by: EO 12553" are both reconciled in this claim, and EO 12107 (amendment) is a later event.
savings_reason: Neither EO 12292 nor EO 12363 contains a savings clause for EO 11434 (the held texts of both contain no "remain in effect", "continue in effect" or similar wording). Sections 1, 3 and 5 only assigned policy-making and regulation-making duties and a delegation, and Sections 2 and 4 concerned boards of an order that was itself revoked; none created property, rights or functions that survive the revocations, and regulations issued under them are completed acts, not continuing commands of this order.
conflict_resolutions: {"FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT": "The two readings concern different instruments. EO 12292 Sec. 10(i) ends EO 11434 only in part (Sections 1, 3 and 5, as it says by number), and Sec. 10(h) revokes only Part III of EO 11264. EO 12363 Sec. 3 revokes EO 11264 as amended in its entirety, and reaches EO 11434 only through that parent order: it ends Sections 2 and 4, which operate only on EO 11264, and does not touch Sections 1, 3 and 5, which had ended already. The claim uses each instrument for the sections it reaches."}
earlier_end_check: Earlier ends were considered. Sections 1, 3 and 5 end on EO 12292's stated effective date, 1981-02-15, and no earlier instrument is held. For Sections 2 and 4 the earlier candidate is EO 12292 Sec. 10(h) (Part III of EO 11264), which reaches only the Board of Examiners and is a partial later event, not an end of Section 2 as a whole; EO 12292 Sec. 10(i) left Sections 2 and 4 unrevoked. The OFR disposition notes are reconciled: "Revoked in part by: EO 12292" is the end of Sections 1, 3 and 5; "Amended by: EO 12107" is a later event; the EO 12363 entry is the end of Sections 2 and 4; "Revoked by: EO 12553" is the formal disposition of 1986-02-25. The dossier lists "cited by number, no change provision located: EO:1126", which is a mis-parse of the heading "Executive Order No. 1126If" in Section 4 (the order's own reference to EO 11264). The U.S. Code hits are the notes to 22 U.S.C. 3901 and 3930, which repeat EO 12292's revocation list and record EO 11264 as revoked by EO 12363.
scope_check: The dossier inventory omitted Section 1 and split Section 4 into five fragments; the corrected inventory is five clauses (Sections 1 to 5) covering characters 1055-3765 of the held text, so every operative section of the order is inventoried. The preamble (authority recital) is not an operative command. EO 12292 revoked three of the five sections by number; the other two are ended by the revocation of EO 11264, the instrument they operate on.
independent_command_check: Section 3 (a delegation of statutory authority) and Section 1 (policy-making duty) are independent of the Boards but were revoked together on 1981-02-15. Section 4 is an amendment that, under the strike-and-insert ruling, continues with its parent (Section 21 of EO 11264) and ends with it. Section 2 operates only through EO 11264. No clause continued past 1982-05-21.
savings_check: No savings clause in EO 12292 or EO 12363; nothing in EO 12553 preserves EO 11434 (it revokes it "and any amendments thereto"). Rights or functions under the Foreign Service Act of 1980 are statutory and independent of this order.

research_rationale: EO 13322 (signed 2003-12-30; 69 FR 231, Federal Register of January 2, 2004) is the 2004 federal pay-adjustment order. Its Sec. 1 to 6 state the pay schedules (statutory pay systems, Senior Executive Service, executive and other salaries, uniformed services, locality payments, administrative law judges), Sec. 7 gives their effective dates and Sec. 8 supersedes EO 13282 as amended by EO 13291. EO 13332 (signed 2004-03-03; 69 FR 10891) says in its Sec. 8 that "Executive Order 13322 of December 30, 2003, is superseded." The end is recorded as 2004-03-03 with the later schedule-effective dates disclosed. The three selected machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR and the OFR order catalog) are used only for the coverage each states; none yields an earlier ending instrument, and EO 13332 is the only instrument that ends this order.
savings_reason: EO 13332 contains no savings clause for EO 13322, but it makes its own schedules effective on the same dates as this order's: "Schedule 8 is effective on January 1, 2004." and "The other schedules contained herein are effective on the first day of the first pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2004." Pay for pay periods before the supersession was earned under the schedules of EO 13322 or of its replacement and is a completed historical consequence, and the supersession of EO 13282 in Sec. 8 of this order is a completed effect; no continuing independent command of EO 13322 survives the supersession.
earlier_end_check: No earlier end. The dossier chain lists no event. Of the two later-events:ofr_catalog hits, "Superseded by: EO 13332, March 3, 2004" is the ending instrument used here, and the cross-reference to EO 13291 (March 21, 2003) is explained by Sec. 8 of this order itself: EO 13291 amended EO 13282, the order this one supersedes, and predates EO 13322, so it neither amends nor ends it. The one U.S. Code hit is the 5 U.S.C. 5332 note listing prior pay adjustments, which records EO 13322 as superseded by EO 13332. No clause has an end date or condition of its own; Sec. 7 states starting dates.
scope_check: The inventory is the dossier's 16 segments: Sec. 1 to 8 and their subsections 1(a)-(c), 3(a)-(c) and 5(a)-(b). Schedules 1 to 10 are attached graphics (the held text has only image markers on PDF pages 3 to 10); they are incorporated by Sec. 1 to 6 and carry no end of their own. The entire supersession is express and covers the whole order ("Executive Order 13322 of December 30, 2003, is superseded."); no part of the order is carved out.
independent_command_check: No clause is independent of the schedules except Sec. 5(b) (OPM implementation and notice) and Sec. 8 (supersession of EO 13282). Neither has a duration of its own and no held source dates its performance, so both are recorded as ending with the order, with the alternatives disclosed in their reasons.
savings_check: EO 13332 has no savings clause; accrued pay under the schedules is the only residue and it is spent by payment, with no continuing independent command.
